card.name: Book prices and buying info
card.fires_on: Dollar signs, decimal points, and the parentheses or currency tags right after a book or product price, plus "Buy" and "sellers" in purchase listings.

modes.label: Price symbols
modes.description: The dollar sign, decimal point or opening parenthesis in a listed price for a book.

modes.label: After a price
modes.description: A bracket or currency tag following a price, giving format or country.

modes.label: Purchase wording
modes.description: Words in shopping blocks that point to where to buy.
modes.example: Edition/Copyright: 7TH 06 More prices and<< sellers>> below.
